Hi Monica / Markus,

Hope you both are well. Wanted to introduce Nico Garcia — a strong candidate SummitSearch is currently representing for the Senior Data Infrastructure Engineer role you posted. Quick highlights:
- 6+ years building low-latency streaming infra (Kafka/FluentD) and design/ops of feature stores
- Recent role: Staff Data Engineer at SignalStream (scale-up); led migration to GPU-backed feature store
- Technical interview performance: system design + debugging threading/locking problems; solid Python + C++ background

Attached is Nico's resume (Nico_Garcia_Resume.pdf). He is currently on a 4-week notice and is targeting a total comp range of $230–260k (flexible).

If you want to move forward, Nico is available for an initial 45-minute screen next week. Proposed time windows (PDT):
- Tue 10/19: 9:30–11:30am or 3:00–5:00pm
- Wed 10/20: 10:00–12:00pm

Would you like me to coordinate calendar invites directly with Nico, or should I send you his availability and have you schedule?

Best,

Subject: Re: Intro: Nico Garcia — quick debrief (10/19 screen)

Markus / Lauren — quick internal notes following the 45m screen with Nico (we had Markus + me on call):

Summary:
- Solid system design thinking: proposed a layered feature ingestion pipeline with sharding and backpressure handling that matched our scale concerns
- Strong debugging: walked through a live threading/locking scenario and surfaced potential race conditions and mitigation strategies (locks -> lock-free queues)
- Background: built at scale (SignalStream), comfortable pairing on C++ and Python and has latency profiled on GPU feature stores

Strengths:
- Clear ownership instincts and pragmatic tradeoffs (latency vs. freshness)
- Good service-level thinking for large data pipelines

Concerns:
- Limited leadership experience owning cross-functional projects (mostly IC/tech lead at previous org) — could be a gap for manager-track expectations
- A couple of small gaps on our infra stack details (Kinesis vs Kafka nuances) but he learns quickly

Recommendation: Move to next round (full loop with Eng + Infra ops + PM). Targeting on-site panel or extended virtual loop; prioritize a deep dive on his system-in-distributed-systems experience and a behavioral with cross-team examples. Also ask for 2 references (manager + peer).

I captured quick bullets in the attached 20261019-interview-notes.txt. If you both agree, I'll ask Rebecca to set up the full loop for next week.

Thanks,
Monica
